items.context: Cozy games, cryptids and ghost stories 👀 Do you have a favourite game that mixes all three?
items.text: Strange Horticulture is the closest I can think of: a quiet little plant shop with a slightly spooky mystery running underneath. No cryptids, but the mood fits.
